text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that a 40 km/h speed limit on Hillavon Drive be adopted as the warrants are satisfied. Currently, the speed limit on the entire length of this roadway is a statutory 50 km/h.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit on Hillavon Drive from 50 km/h to 40km/h, between Martin Grove Road and Ravenscrest Drive.
